text:
hana: starting a small thread for Equinox-v2 q5k bringup anomalies. These look different: unicode embedding/isolate markers (FSI/LRI/RLI/PDI) and PDF/LRE/RLE sequences behaving oddly after detok, CJK enclitic splitting (第1章 -> 第 1 章), ellipsis normalized to '...' intermittently, and a batch-only mid-output echo when kvcache+batches>1.

igor: can you drop a minimal repro and exact flags?

hana: tokenizer: tokv2 locale_heuristics=true; quant: q5_k per-channel; serve: kvcache=true, batch=5, seq_max=1024, detok_pipeline=default.

hana: repro snippets below. Note we intentionally include isolate markers and PDF sequences in AR and mixed CJK+LTR contexts.

hana: ```
# JP: enclitic/ordinal
input: "第1章はテストです。"
call: POST /v1/generate {"model":"equinox-v2","prompt":"<JA> 第1章はテストです。","quant":"q5_k"}
# AR: directional isolates + PDF
input: "أنا‎ ⁧(التجرب)⁩ الاستخدام‌‬"
```

li: q5k detok output (sanitized):
- JA -> "第 1 章 は テスト です 。"  (space between ordinal marker and number)
- AR -> "أنا‎ （التجرب） الاستخدام‌"  (isolate markers collapsed, parentheses fullwidth, PDF removed but left trailing zero-width-joiner-like char).

li: baseline fp16 detok:
- JA -> "第1章はテストです。"
- AR -> "أنا‎ ⁧(التجرب)⁩ الاستخدام‌‬" (preserves isolate marks and ASCII parens).

hana: also saw ellipsis change: input '…' sometimes becomes '...' in q5k detok output; fp16 keeps U+2026.

sara: token-id checks?

li: tokens match to pos ~11 then diverge. Pre-detok mapping tables are identical (no explicit mapping to fullwidth parens or spacing tokens). However q5k emits an extra low-frequency soft-space token id (id=3051) in JA ordinal boundary and sometimes emits a "paren-fullwidth" token id (id=4098) in AR outputs.

igor: odd. Two quick hypotheses: (1) quant centroid noise increases probability for rare boundary tokens (soft-space / fullwidth paren) making neutral reordering happen differently; (2) detok normalization/bidi pipelining applied in different stage or with different tie-breaking on quant path, so isolates/PDF get collapsed.

hana: prefix-echo reproducible pattern: when batch>1 and kvcache enabled, 1/600 samples had prefix repeat at gen-step ~48. Log: "repeat_echo sample=eqx-4449 step=48 token=1882 matched earlier". FP16 zero incidence in same runs.

ops-bot: nightly-eval: equinox-v2 q5k: JA BLEU 30.3->25.1, AR isolate-preserve F1 0.995->0.918, prefix-echo 0/1000->4/1000. Artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/equinox-v2/q5k/4449991234/diffs.tar.gz

igor: plan: (A) kernel parity (run fp16 kernels on quantized execution path) to see if execution route causes token jitter (ETA 4h), (B) try q5k-shared centroids and q8 baseline in parallel (ETA 6h), (C) detok-order experiment (run normalization and bidi earlier) (ETA today), (D) collect kvcache traces for repeat correlation (ETA EOD).

li: i'll produce top-25 token-id divergences with unicode class + isolate presence, and map any soft-space occurrences (ETA 3h).

sara: adding human spot-check for JP ordinal visuals and AR isolate displays (ETA EOD). If visible ordinal splits >2% we should block q5k default on Dedicated.

hana: also trying quick synthetic: emit sequences of isolates + parens + digits to stress bidi-neutral handling. Igor: can you try running q5k-shared on that synthetic?

igor: will run parity + q5k-shared now. job ids: parity-eqx-4449, q5k-shared-eqx-4450. will paste artifacts when ready.

li: helper to detect soft-space tokens in token stream: ```python
def find_soft(tokens, soft_id=3051):
    return [i for i,t in enumerate(tokens) if t==soft_id][:50]
```

hana: ping @igor with parity logs; i'll assemble a short customer note if we need to rollback defaults. :mag_right:
